review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib's Mathlib/ tree for ConvexSubgroup, coarsening and IsConvex, and checked the Mathlib/RingTheory/Valuation directory. The only related hits are the coarsening API in ValuationSubring.lean (around lines 264–372). That API works on valuation subrings and primes through the quotient by a prime ideal. It does not restrict a valuation to a convex subgroup of its value units. I found no Mathlib structure for convex subgroups, so the ConvexSubgroup imported from TauCeti is not a competing copy. The construction in this file, `restrictToConvex`, sends values outside H to 0 and lands in `WithZero H.toSubgroup`. It is a different construction from `Valuation.comap` and from the coarsening maps. The private `restrictToConvexFun` is only the underlying function of the bundled valuation, so it is not a competing concept. I found no justified duplicate. The remaining uncertainty is that a Mathlib file I did not grep could hold an equivalent construction under another name.
